title: The Last Debt Revisited
author: Tamsin Sandoval
blurb: Ivo Montrose, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
